organic.title: Multi-Task Learning for Dense Prediction Tasks: A Survey
organic.snippet: Abstract—With the advent of deep learning, many dense prediction tasks, i.e. tasks that produce pixel-level predictions, have seen significant performance improvements. organic.title: DenseVLM: A Retrieval and Decoupled Alignment Framework
organic.snippet: Overall, DenseVLM offers a generalizable solution for improving dense representations in vision-language models across various backbones, which is essential for open-vocabulary dense prediction tasks.
